MailVault.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/MailVault/ with isolated venv. Use 'mailvault import-eml /path/to/archive' to bulk-import .eml files. Configure himalaya for live sync.

PocketVault.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/PocketVault/ with isolated venv. Press 'g' inside the app to configure API tokens (Crew, Monster, Robinhood).

WarpStrand-Driver.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/WarpStrand-Driver/ with isolated venv and config migration.
